channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Minneapolis City Council looks to solve No. 1 problem downtown: Where to go No. 2
item.description: Businesses and homelessness advocacy groups say people are relieving themselves in public out of desperation. The council is exploring high-tech restrooms.

item.title: Analysis: Justin Jefferson was one of the NFL’s easiest $35 million-a-year decisions
item.description: The Vikings have everything they want in their star receiver. Compare that with the choice Dallas faces with wideout George Pickens.

item.title: Strokes, Lumineers lead Minnesota Yacht Club’s 2026 lineup
item.description: The third annual mid-July festival on St. Paul’s Harriet Island will also feature Matchbox Twenty, Black Keys, Cage the Elephant and Lord Huron.

item.title: Does Bones Hyland represent a changing of (point) guard for Timberwolves?
item.description: The veteran received playing time over Rob Dillingham in Monday night’s loss to the Phoenix Suns.

item.title: Reusse: The amazing hockey life of John Mayasich seems fitting for a book
item.description: Eveleth, Gophers and U.S. Olympic hockey legend John Mayasich is going strong at 92 ... he’s just not getting better at curling and golf.

item.title: State seeks takeover at UCare after ‘hazardous’ financial conditions at health insurer
item.description: The court petition for ‘rehabilitation’ would allow for an orderly wind down at the HMO, regulators say, plus a smooth transition for enrollees.

item.title: Met Council members oversee Twin Cities transit, but rarely ride it
item.description: In the last year, just half of those appointed to the Metropolitan Council have taken advantage of the free Metro Transit rides that come with their job.

item.title: DHS disputes Augsburg’s account of ICE arrest as enforcement actions escalate in Minneapolis
item.description: As conflicting accounts arise about the arrest at the university, ICE activity in the Cedar-Riverside neighborhood sparked protest and one observer was arrested in north Minneapolis.

item.title: Minneapolis City Council approves 2026 budget, spares mayor’s office cuts
item.description: The mayor has five days to decide whether to sign the spending plan, which will increase property taxes.

item.title: Crashes, delays as winter storm brings snow, gusty winds to much of Minnesota
item.description: Road conditions continued to deteriorate Tuesday afternoon into the evening causing crashes and delays.
